name: double-feature
description: Self-hosted movie-night app: draw random films from curated lists, then pick one by ranked-choice vote.

scripts.refresh-dynamic: node -e "import('./server/refresh.js').then(async m => { const r = await m.refreshDynamicLists(); console.log(JSON.stringify(r.results ?? r, null, 2)); process.exit(0); })"
